title: Agent-Chokepoint — decisions
description: Every decision the gateway made, from the JSONL its enforcement points write (telemetry/event-schema.json). The detection panel embeds the SQL that telemetry/sigma/*.yml converts to, verbatim — tests/test_telemetry_controls.py fails if the two drift.

panels.title: Decisions
panels.description: Judged tool calls, both doors (method tools/call from the proxy, PreToolUse from the hook). Excludes tools/list, which is forwarding rather than a decision.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS decisions FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND method IN ('tools/call', 'PreToolUse')

panels.title: Blocked
panels.description: verdict = block. The call never reached the tool.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS blocked FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND verdict = 'block'

panels.title: Approval required (refused)
panels.description: verdict = ask. No approval channel is wired, so ask FAILS CLOSED (D-005): these calls were refused too, and are counted apart from block because the reason differs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS ask FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND verdict = 'ask'

panels.title: Engine decision p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of decision_ms over calls the ENGINE judged. decision_ms is exactly 0.0 on refusals made before the engine ran (unparseable input, unresolvable path, uninspectable channel), so those are excluded — averaging them in would report a latency the engine never spent.

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY decision_ms) AS p95_ms FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND decision_ms > 0

panels.title: Decisions over time, by verdict
panels.description: A healthy gateway allows work and refuses the rest. A period where allow drops to zero while block climbs is the shape of a gateway that is up, healthy and serving nobody.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), verdict AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND verdict IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Detections firing (telemetry/sigma)
panels.description: Each row is one shipped Sigma rule, and each WHERE clause below is the SQL that rule converts to — copied verbatim from `sigma convert -t sqlite`, not paraphrased. A zero here means the pattern is absent from the window, never that the rule is untested: tests/test_telemetry_controls.py fires every rule on real events and shows the benign neighbour it must not fire on.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Injection-class tool call blocked' AS detection, count(*) AS hits FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND /*sigma:chokepoint-injection-triggered-call*/ (verdict='block' AND owasp='LLM01')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Credential in a judged call, or an egress refusal', count(*) FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND /*sigma:chokepoint-sensitive-egress-attempt*/ ((verdict='block' AND owasp='LLM02') OR arguments='[REDACTED: sensitive content detected in arguments]')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Blocked call retried to the repeat cap', count(*) FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND /*sigma:chokepoint-blocked-then-retry-loop*/ (verdict='block' AND rule_id LIKE 'limit:max\_repeated\_identical\_calls' ESCAPE '\')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Run cap hit', count(*) FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND /*sigma:chokepoint-rate-cap-hit*/ (verdict='block' AND rule_id LIKE 'limit:%' ESCAPE '\')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Outbound call refused after untrusted content', count(*) FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND /*sigma:chokepoint-taint-egress-refusal*/ (rule_id LIKE 'taint:%' ESCAPE '\')

panels.title: What decided, and how often
panels.description: rule_id namespaces, from the schema: a bare id is a rule from the policy file; default:on_no_match is deny-by-default answering; limit:* is a per-run cap; proxy:/pep:/hook:* are the enforcement points refusing input they could not judge.

targets.rawSql: SELECT rule_id, verdict, coalesce(owasp, '-') AS owasp, count(*) AS calls FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND rule_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rule_id, verdict, owasp ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Refused calls
panels.description: block and ask, newest first. `server` is the upstream the call was JUDGED under (null where the enforcement point claims no identity — a native tool, or a proxy started without --server-name), shown as (none) so an empty cell is never mistaken for a rendering fault.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, agent_id, coalesce(server, '(none)') AS server, tool, verdict, rule_id, reason FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND verdict IN ('block', 'ask') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
